paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Tom was at football, and Mom was in the garden. Lily answered the house phone. "Hello, this is Lily," she said. "Hi, Lily! It's Mia," said a girl. "Where are you?" asked Lily. "I'm at my grandma's house in a village," said Mia. "Everything here is boring!" "What's the matter?" asked Lily. "The weather is bad, and it rains all day," said Mia. "I can't go out, and I have only an old book."

Lily looked at Pip on the floor. "Is there a game or a toy?" she asked. "No," said Mia. "Grandma has only old things." Then Mia said, "Wait! There's something in the kitchen." "It's a small dog with curly white hair!" "His hair is like a small white cloud!" "He wants to play with me." "He moves very quickly," she said, and she laughed. Lily laughed too and said, "I want to see him!"

"Now nothing is boring," said Mia. "Please write my grandma's number, Lily." Lily took a pencil and some paper. "OK, go on," said Lily. "Zero, five, three, two, six, one, nine, nine, four," said Mia slowly. Lily wrote the number and read it back. "Yes, that's right!" said Mia. "Please call me again." "I'll call you after dinner," said Lily. She smiled at Pip, and he put his head on her foot. It was a happy call in the end. Mia had a new friend in the village.
text.summary: Mia calls Lily from her grandma's house in a village. It rains, and everything is boring, but then Mia finds a small dog with curly hair and gives Lily the phone number.
